notes: Work in one place, see it in both: a push now MERGES with the cloud instead of refusing — sheets edited on this device go up, sheets edited on the other side come down, and Purchase / Bar Stock Issue / the invoice register are merged entry by entry, so nothing is lost when both sides were used.
